title: Understanding a rule in your way

captions.energy: Building a clear framework of understanding

meaning: You can build a shared view on clear foundations while leaving each person room to understand it in their own way.
text: When explanations multiply around you, you may need a clear foundation together. The Hierophant in the physical position of Ajna suggests comparing experience with established knowledge, consulting a teaching or discussing learned rules. The Emperor in energy supports a constructive motive: building an orderly understanding in which reasons can be checked and connected. The Hermit in emotions brings inward concentration, a wish to consider a shared explanation against your own experience first. Agreement between you need not arrive at exactly the same moment.

For example, you are learning the rules of a new shared activity. You read an explanation, arrange the sequence of actions and each need a little time for it to settle. **A shared view grows stronger when each person has a route towards understanding.** One conversation can provide common footing and different personal discoveries. You can return with more precise questions and refine the framework rather than simply repeat what you read.

The difficulty is treating a well organised explanation as a view already shared. While one person is still reflecting, the other may keep referring to the clear rule. Outwardly you discuss the same thing, but inner agreement has yet to form. Quiet room for each person's own wording helps distinguish genuine shared understanding from polite silence after a good explanation.
